sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: The number of critical points of the function $f(x)=\begin{cases}\left|\frac{\sin x}{x}\right| & , x \neq 0 \\ 1 & , x=0\end{cases}$ in the interval $(-2\pi,2\pi)$ is equal to :
stem.hi: फलन $f(x)=\begin{cases}\left|\frac{\sin x}{x}\right| & , x \neq 0 \\ 1 & , x=0\end{cases}$ के अंतराल $(-2\pi,2\pi)$ में क्रांतिक बिंदुओं की संख्या है :

feynman.en: Critical points are where $f'=0$ or $f'$ does not exist. The modulus makes corners where $\sin x=0$, and the smooth humps have flat tops where $\tan x=x$.
feynman.hi: क्रांतिक बिंदु वहाँ हैं जहाँ $f'=0$ हो या $f'$ का अस्तित्व न हो। मापांक $\sin x=0$ पर कोने बनाता है, और चिकने उभारों के शिखर वहाँ हैं जहाँ $\tan x=x$।

steps.en: $x=\pm\pi$: $\frac{\sin x}{x}$ changes sign, so $|\cdot|$ has corners; $f'$ does not exist ($2$ points).
steps.hi: $x=\pm\pi$: $\frac{\sin x}{x}$ का चिह्न बदलता है, अतः $|\cdot|$ में कोने हैं; $f'$ का अस्तित्व नहीं ($2$ बिंदु)।

steps.en: $\tan x=x$ has one root in $\left(\pi,\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$ and its mirror in $\left(-\frac{3\pi}{2},-\pi\right)$ ($2$ points). Total $5$.
steps.hi: $\tan x=x$ का एक मूल $\left(\pi,\frac{3\pi}{2}\right)$ में और उसका प्रतिबिंब $\left(-\frac{3\pi}{2},-\pi\right)$ में ($2$ बिंदु)। कुल $5$।
